players.product: Siyuan (MLU) cloud AI chips and accelerator cards, AI servers and intelligent computing cluster systems for large-model training and inference

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Chen Tianshi (2025 annual results briefing), asked about internet companies developing their own AI chips: their chips are built around their own main businesses or specific application scenarios as complete industry solutions, whereas Cambricon's are general-purpose AI chips designed for diverse AI scenarios (vision, speech, natural-language processing, traditional machine learning), offered as a cloud-edge-device, hardware-software co-designed, training-inference unified product series with one software ecosystem. He said the company's products are deployed at scale in telecom operators, finance and internet and passed customers' demanding environment validation; it mainly serves domestic customers. Its intelligent computing cluster business combines its own accelerator cards or servers with partners' server, network and storage equipment and its cluster-management software, for customers with weaker AI deployment capability.

Legal proceedings (2025 annual results briefing): on the labour-dispute lawsuit filed by former executive Liang Jun, chairman Chen Tianshi said the company has retained a legal team, will actively respond to what it calls the departed executive's improper claims, and that the case has no impact on its day-to-day R&D and operations; it will disclose progress as required.
